description: This file defines a Buttons class for managing toolbar buttons in the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, including button creation, state updates, and event handling.

classes.name: Buttons
classes.description: Class managing toolbar buttons for Summernote editor, including initialization, destruction, button building, and state updates.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes Buttons instance with context, setting UI, options, language, and key mappings.

methods.name: representShortcut
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing keyboard shortcuts for editor methods, adapting for Mac or PC.

methods.name: button
methods.description: Creates a button element with given options, applying tooltip and container settings.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up toolbar, image, link, and table buttons, and initializes font map.

methods.name: isFontInstalled
methods.description: Checks if a font is installed or ignored based on options.

methods.name: isFontDeservedToAdd
methods.description: Determines if a font should be added to font options, excluding generic families.

methods.name: addToolbarButtons
methods.description: Defines and memoizes toolbar buttons for formatting, lists, alignment, tables, media, and other editor functions.

methods.name: addImagePopoverButtons
methods.description: Defines image-related buttons for resizing, floating, and removal.

methods.name: addLinkPopoverButtons
methods.description: Defines link editing and unlinking buttons.

methods.name: addTablePopoverButtons
methods.description: Defines table manipulation buttons for adding/removing rows and columns.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds button groups into a container based on provided group definitions.

methods.name: updateCurrentStyle
methods.description: Updates button states based on current editor style, including font, size, and line height.

methods.name: updateBtnStates
methods.description: Sets active state for buttons based on predicate functions.

methods.name: tableMoveHandler
methods.description: Handles mouse movement over table dimension picker to visually indicate table size.
